lines.zh: 我在岩石坡上小跑，脚步密。
lines.en: I trot up the rocky slope with quick, tight steps.

lines.zh: 我探头探脑地走，一路张望。
lines.en: I walk peeking about, checking every direction.

lines.zh: 石子在我脚下滚了一路。
lines.en: Pebbles roll away under my feet.
I keep hunched, ready to spring at any moment.

lines.zh: 我绕到石头背阴的一面。
lines.en: I work around to the shaded side of the rock.
The leaf on my head shakes hard.
I shift along in small, careful steps.

lines.zh: 我沿着山崖边走，不怕高。
lines.en: I walk the cliff edge; heights don't bother me.
I stop every few paces to listen.

lines.zh: 我把手指插进石缝借力。
lines.en: I hook my fingers into cracks for grip.

lines.zh: 风把我的气味往你那边送。
lines.en: The wind carries my scent toward you.

lines.zh: 我蹲在石头上，尾巴没有，就晃手。
lines.en: I crouch on a rock and swing my hands instead of a tail.
I scrape a claw along the stone.
I open my mouth and test my teeth.
I stare at a small patch of glare.
I tilt my head, then the other way.
My breathing comes thin and quiet.
I sit, but my feet keep moving.

lines.zh: 我在等石头后面有动静。
lines.en: I'm waiting for something behind the rocks to move.
I turn my palm over and look at it.
I count my surroundings one more time.
I nod along to nothing.

lines.zh: 我在听，很远的地方有响。
lines.en: I'm listening; something sounds far off.

lines.zh: 岩石群系的风，吹不动我。
lines.en: The rocky biome's wind can't budge me.

lines.zh: 我一直在看你，别装作没看见。
lines.en: I've been watching you; don't pretend otherwise.
What's in your pockets?
I'm small, but I'm not slow.
One of your steps takes me three.

lines.zh: 我站在这里，看你怎么办。
lines.en: I'll stand here and see what you do.
Something hangs at your waist.

lines.zh: 我抬头的时候，你正好低头。
lines.en: I look up just as you look down.
Your boots are thick.
Heights don't scare me. Do they scare you?
I'm measuring how wide you are.

lines.zh: 我退到石头后面，只露出眼。
lines.en: I slip behind a rock, only my eyes showing.
You want to catch me? Try.

lines.zh: 我就在你脚边，抬头看你。
lines.en: I'm at your feet, looking up at you.
Your hand is bigger than my head.
You move, I move.
I roll half a turn and find my feet.
It hurts; I make an ugly sound.
I clutch my ribs and suck in air.
The hit flattens me against the ground.
Green blood runs into the rock cracks.
My teeth click together.
I narrow my eyes and edge back.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，重新压低身子。
lines.en: I shake once and crouch low again.
This still won't break me.
Put it on the rock.
That smell is strong.
I sniff and back off.
You're trying to distract me.
I'm not falling for that; stop trying.
Throw it farther away.
I'm hungry, but I'd rather fight.
Keep the food for yourself.
I trip you and you wobble.
I brace against your leg; I'm hard as stone.
I duck right under you.

lines.zh: 我撞上你的膝盖，脚一滑。
lines.en: I hit your knee and my feet slip.
You shove me and I roll twice.
I come to a stop against your leg.

lines.zh: 你退了两步，我一步没让。
lines.en: You gave two steps; I gave none.
The gap is too narrow; we can't get past.

lines.zh: 它站在比我高的石头上。
lines.en: It stands on a rock higher than mine.
It grabs my leaf; I swat it.
We climb the rocky slope together.
Whichever charges first, the other follows.
We split the same boulder.
Its claws are blunter than mine.
We crouch back to back.

lines.zh: 它一叫，我就知道要动了。
lines.en: When it cries out, I know it's time.
This stone is just right for throwing.
I pick up a bone chip and chew it.
I hide the shiny thing in a crack.

lines.zh: 我抱着一块比我大的石头。
lines.en: I carry a stone bigger than myself.
This can be a weapon.
I pick it up, then toss it.
Whatever falls to the ground is mine.
I cup it in both hands.
I hide it behind me so you can't see.
You turned around. This is what I waited for.
I launch off the rock.

lines.zh: 我的目标就是你，别怀疑。
lines.en: The target is you; don't doubt it.
The rocks block the wind for me.
I spread my claws; close now.
I've worked out where your foot will land.
Riding the wind, I press in.
Your head turns too slowly.
This height is perfect for a leap.
I hug the ground where you can't see me.
I have the better position.
I'm right behind you.
Don't turn; I'm close.
My teeth are already showing.
I keep pace with quick little steps.
You turn into the rocks; I slip in after.
I'm up high; I see clearly.

lines.zh: 你的脚印在碎石上留不住。
lines.en: Your prints don't hold on the scree.
I'm waiting for you to trip yourself.
You're not as fast as me.

lines.zh: 我换了个石头，离你更近。
lines.en: I switch boulders and get closer.
You stop to breathe; I stop too.
I hold perfectly still until you move away.
You can't hear me.

lines.zh: 我把你的路线堵了一半。
lines.en: I've blocked half your routes.
We're pressing in from both sides.
Look up, and I'm right above.
That's the last stretch of your road.
Being faster won't help you now.
I've picked my landing spot.
How many more steps do you have?
I dive off the boulder.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在你腰侧划开。
lines.en: My claws open your flank.

lines.zh: 我用整个身子撞你的膝。
lines.en: I throw my whole body into your knee.
That one took your balance.
I dart between your legs.
My teeth are worse than my claws.
Your punch found nothing.
I'm on you again.
That rake takes a strip of cloth.

lines.zh: 我贴得太近，你使不上力。
lines.en: I'm too close for you to swing.
Bite first, then back off.

lines.zh: 你护着膝盖的动作太慢。
lines.en: You guard your knee too late.
That counts as half a win for me.
I land still biting.

lines.zh: 我从山岩的阴影里冒出来。
lines.en: I come out of the shadow of the cliff.
Clots of earth fall as I wake.

lines.zh: 我的头先探出来，然后是手。
lines.en: My head comes out first, then my hands.
This scree slope suits me.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，土渣从背上掉下去。
lines.en: I shake and crumbs slide off my back.

lines.zh: 我把爪子插进新的土里。
lines.en: I sink my claws into fresh soil.
Cold wind pours down the ridge.

lines.zh: 我在地势高的地方站定。
lines.en: I take a stand on the high ground.
I count: nobody near.

lines.zh: 我从石头上滚下来，站住了。
lines.en: I tumble off a rock and land on my feet.

lines.zh: 我的影子出现在崖壁上。
lines.en: My shadow shows on the cliff face.

lines.zh: 岩石上多了一个小小的我。
lines.en: One small me is added to these rocks.
I open my mouth and try a sound.
I'm here, and the mountain wind knows it.
I grind the soil flat under my feet.
I look up and see my prey.

lines.zh: 我伏在石后，只露一双眼。
lines.en: I crouch behind stone, only my eyes showing.
I hop twice to loosen up.
Fire burns me and I hop away.

lines.zh: 我摔在石头上，骨头咯了一下。
lines.en: I hit the rocks and a bone jolts.

lines.zh: 我在水里乱抓，抓不到石头。
lines.en: I claw in the water and find no stone.

lines.zh: 泥土和石头一起砸向我。
lines.en: Dirt and stone rain onto me.
An arrow sticks in my leg.
Light coils around me and I can't work free.
I should get back to the soil and rest.

lines.zh: 这里没有石头，我抓不住。
lines.en: No stone here; nothing to hold.
